Independent review corrections expose narrative validity duration/no-expiry semantics and preserve requirement identities when assessment rows are absent, preventing conflicting batch overwrites.

limitations: Tokens conservatively invalidate on any audited workspace change or UTC day rollover; no expiry persistence or migration was added.
Preview computation runs existing database-only mutations in a savepoint that is always rolled back. Returned fields exclude listed runtime-generated identifiers, reviewer fields, and timestamps.
File evidence review remains in the dedicated byte-verifying evidence workflow; proposal previews report it as blocked.
Batch previews are limited to 200 pending proposals and conservatively skip overlapping targets. Individual approval plus refreshed previews resolves overlaps.
Focused proposal suites ran on SQLite and isolated PostgreSQL, plus server typecheck. Full suite, browser checks, and builds remain lead-owned.
Changes are uncommitted. Core index exports and integration changes are lead-owned.

changes: Narrative evidence proposed fields now state collectionTime and validityPeriod. Exact approval-generated timestamps remain qualified via generatedFields. Raw validDays stays included in the token-bound payload.
Every requirement change now includes its known nodeId as entityId even without a current assessment row; existing overlap detection consequently skips conflicting same-node proposals.
review_corrections.validation: 19 focused SQLite tests, server typecheck, and scoped diff check passed. Independent reviewer notified for follow-up verification.

postgres_order_correction.root_cause: snapshot() hashed StateTable.list() result order despite that query having no ORDER BY. PostgreSQL plan changes returned identical records in a different array order.
postgres_order_correction.fix: Sort only top-level snapshot record collections and workspace membership inputs by stable ID. Preserve nested payload/content/check array order.
postgres_order_correction.validation: Final focused suite passed 21/21 on SQLite and 21/21 on PostgreSQL; server typecheck and scoped diff check passed. Existing stale-state/payload/source tests remain strict; ordered observed steps explicitly remain bound.
